questions.q: Which system calculates the premium for policy ERH-2026-0042?
questions.reason: The policy system sells the policy and calculates the premium. FS-CD then bills and collects it.

questions.q: What does FS-CD own in the premium-to-cash chain?
options: Billing, collection and one balance per policyholder
questions.reason: FS-CD is the sub-ledger with one account per policyholder. FI only receives the totals.

questions.q: What does FI receive from FS-CD for premiums?
options: Daily totals posted to the general ledger
Every single policy as a separate GL line, typed by hand
questions.reason: FS-CD posts summarised daily totals to the GL, so the GL shows one number per account.

questions.q: Why is there no VAT on Hygge Hjem's premium?
options: The premium is below the VAT limit
VAT is added later by the bank
questions.reason: Insurance is exempt from VAT. Premiums carry insurance tax instead.

questions.q: What is the insurance tax on a premium of DKK 120,000 at the lesson's 1.1%?
What is the total amount billed to Hygge Hjem on 01.03?
questions.reason: Premium 120,000 plus insurance tax 1,320 gives 121,320.

questions.q: Which posting does billing create?
questions.reason: The policyholder owes the total (debit receivables). Written premium and the tax owed to the state are credited.

questions.q: Who is the insurance tax collected for?
options: The state, paid on to Skattestyrelsen
questions.reason: Nordica collects the tax from policyholders and pays it to Skattestyrelsen, so it sits in 290100 until paid.

questions.q: What is account 140000 in the lesson?
options: The reconciliation account for premium receivables, fed by FS-CD
questions.reason: 140000 holds the total of all policyholder receivables. Nobody posts to it by hand.

questions.q: What do the main and sub transactions in FS-CD do?
options: They drive GL account determination, for example premium to 300000
questions.reason: The pair describes what the item is and maps to GL accounts through account determination.

questions.q: The premium is due 15.03 and paid 13.03. What happens regarding dunning?
options: No reminder is created because the item is cleared before the due date
questions.reason: Cleared items are not picked up by the dunning run.

questions.q: What does the +71 payment ID on an FI-kort allow?
options: Automatic matching of the payment to the open premium
questions.reason: The ID printed on the premium notice returns on the bank statement so the item can be found automatically.

questions.q: Which file formats can carry the bank statement?
questions.reason: camt.053 is the modern XML format; MT940 is the older one.

questions.q: A bank statement line has no usable reference. What happens?
options: The bank side posts and the payment waits for clarification by a clerk
The payment is rejected by the bank
It is cleared against the oldest invoice automatically in every case
questions.reason: The money is in the bank, but the policyholder item stays open until someone matches it.

questions.q: What should the balance of 113100 Bank incoming clearing be once all payments are matched?
questions.reason: It is a waiting room. A growing balance means unmatched payments.

questions.q: Which posting records the bank side on 13.03?
options: Debit 110000 Bank; credit 113100 Bank incoming clearing, 121,320
questions.reason: The bank account goes up through the clearing account. The second step credits receivables.

questions.q: What is written premium?
options: The premium billed for the whole policy period
Only the premium for cover already given
questions.reason: Written premium (GWP) is the full amount billed. Earned premium is the part for cover already given.

questions.q: By 31.03, how much of the DKK 120,000 premium is earned?
questions.reason: Cover started 01.03, so one of 12 months is earned: 120,000 ÷ 12 = 10,000.

questions.q: What is the unearned premium reserve (UPR) at 31.03 for this policy?
questions.reason: 11 of 12 months are still to be covered: 120,000 − 10,000 = 110,000.

questions.q: Which month-end posting records the UPR?
options: Debit 300500 Change in UPR 110,000; credit 250000 UPR 110,000
questions.reason: The change in UPR reduces the premium result, and the reserve is a liability.

questions.q: The company-level March figures show gross written premium 2,400,000 and change in UPR −800,000. What is earned premium?
What does the final notice in dunning warn about?
options: That cover will stop if the premium is not paid by a stated deadline
That the policy price is rising
That the bank will close the account
questions.reason: The final notice is the legal warning needed before cancellation for non-payment.

questions.q: A policy is cancelled for non-payment. What happens to the insurance tax on the uncovered period?
options: It is reversed together with the premium
It stays owed to Skattestyrelsen in full
It is paid to Hygge Hjem
questions.reason: Nordica should not owe tax on premium it never collects. Confirm the exact treatment with your tax team.

questions.q: What is a bad debt provision?
options: An expense booked now for premium that probably will not be paid
questions.reason: A provision covers doubtful debts while the item stays open. A write-off closes a debt that is lost.

questions.q: Which receivable is NOT a premium and lives in FI-AR?
options: A reinsurance recovery from Rhein Re
A dunning fee on a premium
questions.reason: Reinsurance recoveries go to 141000 through classic FI accounts receivable, not FS-CD.

questions.q: What is a recourse (regres) claim?
options: Money Nordica claims back from a third party who caused the damage
questions.reason: After paying a claim, the insurer can claim the amount from the person responsible or their insurer.

questions.q: Which screen shows a policyholder's FS-CD account balance?
questions.reason: FPL9 shows the items and balance of an FS-CD contract account. FBL5N shows FI-AR customer items.

questions.q: After payment and month-end, what are the balances for Hygge Hjem's policy on 140000 and 250000?
questions.reason: The premium is paid, so receivables are cleared. The unearned reserve remains until the cover is given.
